name: orchestratore
description: Multi-agent coordinator for Claude Code and Codex: plan once, dispatch independent units in parallel, verify each delivery with a different model, merge only through a deterministic gate.

interface.longDescription: Splits a batch of bugs, fixes or milestones into independent briefs, runs them on parallel sub-agents or Codex processes in isolated worktrees, verifies each delivery with a different model, and merges only through a deterministic gate (tier, allowlist, required checks).
defaultPrompt: Use orchestratore to fix these bugs in parallel: ...
Use orchestratore on the open milestones in ROADMAP.md.
